prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering sign-in steps (sign_in, reorder), finish layout changes (finish, layout), and adoption new flows (adoption, new_flow) consistently hurt performance.
Sign-in redesigns (sign_in, redesign) consistently underperformed, generating multiple losses and zero winning tests.
Sign-in hints (sign_in, hint) and home wait-info updates (home, wait_info) were helpful, driving multiple winning tests.
Adoption new screens (adoption, new_screen) yielded multiple winning tests, though overall performance across tests was mixed.
Predictions were systematically too optimistic for failing changes, redesigns, and guardrail rollbacks.
Predictions systematically underestimated the positive gains achieved by winning tests.

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_screen] pick_friend_sound_preview_new_screen: Insert a dedicated sound and voice preview screen right after pet selection so users can hear pet reactions before confirming adoption. (why: Adoption conversion has high mean time (1017s); adoption new screens have a history of winning tests.)
1: [sign_in, hint] sign_in_account_restoration_hint: Add an explicit reassurance hint explaining that signing in with your original social/email account restores all previously adopted pets. (why: Top support issue was 'Pets missing or reset after signing in again' (8 emails). Sign-in hints are proven top performers.)
2: [home, wait_info] waiting_desktop_render_checklist_wait_info: Display a desktop pet render status checklist on the waiting screen while pet assets compile. (why: Home wait-info updates consistently win; support reported desktop overlay loading failures (3 emails).)
3: [finish, new_flow] home_intro_visibility_troubleshooter_new_flow: Add an interactive desktop pet visibility test button directly on the home_intro screen to confirm the pet displays properly. (why: Finish step has the lowest conversion (64.8%), and support logged 3 reports of pets not showing on desktop.)
4: [adoption, new_screen] adoption_certificate_badge_preview_new_screen: Add a dedicated adoption badge preview screen before rendering starts to highlight completion. (why: Adoption new screens perform well in tests and build user excitement before the wait step.)
5: [choose_path, hint] story_welcome_overview_hint: Add a hint to the welcome story screen clarifying that desktop pets sit on top of open windows without interrupting work. (why: Choose path has a high mean time (514s); clear product positioning sets expectations early.)
6: [home, wait_info] waiting_desktop_shortcut_wait_info: Show desktop pet controls hotkey hints on the waiting screen while rendering finishes. (why: Support theme: 'Unclear how to control, hide or talk to the pet' (3 emails). Wait-info updates drive conversion.)
7: [finish, copy] home_intro_desktop_faq_copy: Revise home_intro headline and body copy to explicitly explain desktop controls and hiding/showing the pet. (why: Finish step drops to 64.8% completion and users report confusion about controlling desktop pets after setup.)
8: [choose_path, copy] choose_path_mode_clarity_copy: Update choose_path headline and body copy to clearly distinguish between ready-made pets and custom photo generation. (why: Choose_path mean completion time is 514s; clearer copy helps users pick the right creation path quickly.)
